item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: Earth, Sun and the apparent motion of the sky
item.stem:
Arjun watches the night sky from his rooftop in Jaipur for three hours. He notices that the Pole Star (Dhruva Tara) stays in almost the same position, while other stars seem to move around it.

Why does the Pole Star appear nearly stationary?

options.A: The Pole Star does not move at all in space
options.B: Earth's rotation axis points very close to the Pole Star
options.C: The other stars pull the Pole Star towards them
options.D: The Pole Star is the brightest star in the night sky
